explication: This repository packages agent skills rather than executable application code. A user chooses a research workflow, which produces a business-facing artifact; when endpoint details are needed, workflow skills use the ScrapeCreators API skill as their data layer. The README documents these capabilities and relationships, but the skill files were not sampled, so the graph does not assert finer-grained runtime steps or service-call behavior.
